Verifying the convergence path for all webhook dispatch functions.

All dispatch functions in `memo_service_webhooks.go` call `webhook.PostAsync`. That enqueues to `asyncPostQueue` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`, where workers call `webhook.Post` for delivery. Now checking `memo_service.go` and `memo_service_comments.go` to confirm the lifecycle events map.
A complete answer has been prepared. Now checking whether memo_service.go duplicates the DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook comment at line 603.

Webhook dispatch logic lives in `memo_service_webhooks.go`, not `memo_service.go` where a stale comment remains at line 603.

Four memo lifecycle events dispatch webhooks:

- created → DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook
- updated → DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook
- deleted → DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook
- comment created → DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook

All converge at `webhook.PostAsync` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`. That function enqueues to `asyncPostQueue`; worker goroutines call `Post` for actual HTTP delivery.

Event-to-function mapping is defined in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` (lines 14–46). Call sites:

- Created — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (CreateMemo)
- Updated — `server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go` (`dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`)
- Deleted — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (DeleteMemo)
- Comment created — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go` (CreateMemoComment)
